description:
BROE auctioneers are delighted to present this spacious 3 bedroom - 3 bathroom own door end of terrace duplex to the market in the exclusive gated development of Newlands Manor. Number 16 is a well-proportioned property measuring an impressive (110 sq.m.) The accommodation briefly comprises of an entrance hall, guest WC, a bright & spacious living room with French doors opening onto Southwest facing balcony and kitchen/dining room. Upstairs there are three bright and spacious sized bedrooms master ensuite and main bathroom. This complex is maintained to a very high standard and benefits from ample communal parking, electric gates, manicured green areas, and private access to 700 acres of parkland at Corkagh Park Demesne. Located just of the Naas Road the property is within walking distance of Clondalkin village where you will find an array of school’s shops restaurants and bars, there are also numerous sporting clubs on your doorstep. Early viewing is highly recommended as this property is sure to create a lot of interest! 

Contact Craig Leap of BROE auctioneers to register your interest.
